claim.text: In RLHF the optimal policy is the reference policy times exp(reward / beta), so a small beta lets one token take the rew

spec.explain: Illustrative toy of arXiv 2203.02155: bars show reference policy reweighted by exp(reward/beta), with the limit that small beta lets one token take the reward.

questions.q: Predict what happens to the bars if beta is set to 0.2 with delta held fixed?
questions.why: Tests prediction of sharpness from small beta.

questions.q: Many think larger beta makes the winner stronger; before moving beta to 1.8, what do you expect?
questions.why: Confronts misunderstanding of KL strength direction.

questions.q: If delta is set to 0.5, will the two bars look nearly equal even with small beta?
questions.why: Tests role of reward gap versus temperature.

questions.q: If delta is set to 3.5, can a large beta still keep the winner from taking all reward?
questions.why: Tests interaction of large gap and strong regularization.

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var beta = state.beta; var delta = state.delta; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var r = Math.exp(delta / beta); var winner = r / (1 + r); var runner = 1 / (1 + r); var baseY = h * 0.78; var maxH = h * 0.52; var bw = 110; var x1 = w * 0.18; var x2 = w * 0.53; var h1 = winner * maxH; var h2 = runner * maxH; var i = 0; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "14px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic"; ctx.fillText("reference reweighted by exp(reward / beta)", 24, 28); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(24, baseY); ctx.lineTo(w - 24, baseY); ctx.stroke(); for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) { var gy = baseY - (i + 1) * maxH / 5; ctx.strokeStyle = "#d5cbbd"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(24, gy); ctx.lineTo(w - 24, gy); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(x1, baseY - h1, bw, h1); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillRect(x2, baseY - h2, bw, h2); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("winner token", x1, baseY + 20); ctx.fillText("runner token", x2, baseY + 20); ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("winner_share = " + fmt(winner), x1, baseY - h1 - 10); ctx.fillText("runner_share = " + fmt(runner), x2, baseY - h2 - 10); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("beta = " + fmt(beta), 24, h - 40); ctx.fillText("delta = " + fmt(delta), 24, h - 22); if (winner > 0.95) { ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText("small beta lets one token take the reward", w * 0.45, h - 30); } else { ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.fillText("regularized split stays near reference", w * 0.45, h - 30); } }
